results.note: Dialogus quaestionum - an important pseudo-Augustinian text from 6th-century Spain. Critical editions in CSEL, Documenta Catholica Omnia. No English translation found despite extensive searching.

De contritione cordis - pseudo-Augustinian devotional work on contrition. Manuscript editions from 15th century onwards. No English translation found in major translation series or open-access collections.

Meditationes - compiled by Jean de Fécamp (11th c.). English translations: John Floyd (Jesuit, 1686) 'The meditations, soliloquia, and manuall...newly translated into English'; George Stanhope (1701) 'Pious breathings'. Multiple 16th-17th c. editions and vernacular translations.

De cognitione verae vitae - actually by Honorius of Autun (12th c.), misattributed to Augustine. Early printed editions (Peter Schoeffer, Mainz, 1474). No English translation found despite wide circulation.
De XII abusionibus saeculi - anonymous Irish moral treatise (630-700), falsely attributed to Augustine and Cyprian. No English translation found; text studied in Latin form primarily.
Breviarium in Psalmos - pseudo-Augustinian psalms commentary. Interpolated medieval compilation partly drawn from Jerome. No complete English translation found in major translation series.
Categoriae X (also Decem Categoriae) - pseudo-Augustinian paraphrase of Aristotle's Categories. 4th-century Latin work. No English translation found; studied in context of medieval logic.
De grammatica - pseudo-Augustinian grammatical treatise. No English translation found despite searching major medieval grammar and rhetoric resources.

De vita eremitica - title shared with Aelred of Rievaulx's 12th-century work (which has English translation). Attribution confusion makes clear determination difficult; original pseudo-Augustinian version has no confirmed English translation.
Principia rhetorices - pseudo-Augustinian rhetoric manual. Published by Migne in PL32 appendix. Scholarly debate on authorship (Augustine vs. pseudo-Augustine). No modern English translation found.
Regula secunda - brief pseudo-Augustinian rule fragment. Word count = 0 in manifest. No English translation located.
Regulae clericis fragmentum - fragmentary pseudo-Augustinian rule. Word count = 0 in manifest. Too brief to translate; no English version found.
Appendix (PL vol. 33) - miscellaneous pseudo-Augustinian material. Large collection (34,806 words). No unified English translation located despite searching specialized patristic resources.
De benedictionibus Jacob Patriarchae - pseudo-Augustinian exegetical work on Jacob's blessings. No English translation found in major translation series or open-access collections.

De mirabilibus sacrae Scripturae - by Augustinus Hibernicus (Irish Augustine, fl. 655). English translations: Gerard MacGinty (PhD thesis 1971) with introduction; John Carey in King of Mysteries: early Irish religious writings (2nd ed., 2000); blog translation on 'Aliens in This World'.

Expositio in Apocalypsim Joannis - pseudo-Augustinian Apocalypse commentary. Digital text in Documenta Catholica Omnia. No English translation located; multiple medieval Apocalypse commentaries exist (Alexander Minorita, Joachim of Fiore) but pseudo-Augustine version untranslated.

Quaestiones Veteris et Novi Testamenti - large pseudo-Augustinian biblical questions work (98,807 words). CSEL critical edition, Documenta Catholica Omnia. No English translation found despite extensive searching.
Quaestiones aliae Veteris et Novi Testamenti - supplementary pseudo-Augustinian biblical questions. No English translation found despite significance in medieval biblical scholarship.
Annotatio in primum psalmum - brief pseudo-Augustinian note on Psalm 1 (301 words). Too fragmentary; no English version located.
Sermones dubii - doubtful pseudo-Augustinian sermons (33,592 words). Large collection in PL 39. No English translation found despite importance in medieval homiletic tradition.
Sermones suppositii de Sanctis - spurious pseudo-Augustinian sermons on saints (36,960 words). Documented in medieval manuscript catalogs. No English translation located.
Sermones suppositii de Scripturis - spurious pseudo-Augustinian biblical sermons (119,929 words). Large collection. No English translation found despite size and medieval circulation.
Sermones suppositii de diversis - spurious pseudo-Augustinian miscellaneous sermons (91,127 words). No English translation located in major translation series.
Sermones suppositii de tempore - spurious pseudo-Augustinian temporal sermons (58,433 words). Large homiletic collection. No English translation found.
De regula verae fidei - pseudo-Augustinian rule of true faith. No English translation found despite searching comprehensive Augustine bibliographies and translation indexes.

In Psalmum XLI - brief pseudo-Augustinian commentary on Psalm 41 (774 words). Augustine's complete Psalm exposition exists in English (NPNF, New City Press), but pseudo-Augustine version untranslated.
De VII vitis et VII donis - pseudo-Augustinian work on seven vices and seven gifts. Likely misattributed (possibly Hugo of St. Victor). No English translation found.
De substantia dilectionis - pseudo-Augustinian treatise on the substance of love/charity. Possibly by Hugh of Saint Victor. No English translation located.
Psalterium - pseudo-Augustinian psalter or psalms work (1,433 words). No English translation found in available collections.
De XII gradibus abusionum - pseudo-Augustinian work on twelve degrees of abuses. Irish moral text (650-660). No complete English translation found despite scholarly study.
De cataclysmo - actually attributed to Quodvultdeus (Bishop of Carthage, d. 454), falsely ascribed to pseudo-Augustine. No English translation found.
De quarta feria - pseudo-Augustinian discourse on Wednesday/fourth day. No English translation located despite searching patristic resources.
De tempore barbarico - pseudo-Augustinian work on barbaric times. No English translation found in major collections.

De vera et falsa poenitentia - pseudo-Augustinian penitence work. Influential on Gratian and medieval penitential theology. No complete modern English translation found despite significance; passages cited in Summa Theologiae.
De Trinitate et unitate Dei - pseudo-Augustinian trinitarian work (PL 42). Word count = 0 in manifest. No English translation located.
De essentia divinitatis - pseudo-Augustinian work on divine essence (PL 42). Word count = 0 in manifest. No English translation found.
De Rusticiano subdiacono - pseudo-Augustinian sermon on deacon Rustician. CSEL 53 critical edition (M. Petschenig, 1910). No English translation located.

Hypomnesticon (Hypognosticon) contra Pelagianos et Coelestianos - pseudo-Augustinian polemical work against Pelagian heresies. Medieval manuscripts survive. No English translation found despite scholarly study of Pelagian controversy.

Caput postremum Soliloquiorum - final chapter of pseudo-Augustine Soliloquies (pseudo-Augustinian 13th-century mystical work distinct from Augustine's genuine Soliloquies). English translations exist for genuine Augustine Soliloquies (Cleveland 1910, Harvard 2022), but pseudo-Augustine mystical version uncertain.
Sermones (PL 47) - pseudo-Augustinian sermons (2,263 words). Fragmentary collection. No English translation located.

Commonitorium de recipiendis Manichaeis - pseudo-Augustinian ecclesiastical instruction on receiving repentant Manichaeans (late 5th/early 6th c.). CSEL/Brepols critical editions exist. No English translation found.
